text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To help build a sauna for Transcend's friend,
I visited the log cabin that served as their base.

text_block_list.name: Transcend's Friend
text_block_list.text:
The blueprints are finished, and the materials are all here~.
Look, here's today's task list!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, foundation stones, heaps of lumber, tarps, plus all the tools...
...Can we really haul all this before the day is over?
choice_data_list: Hmm... should we try looking for some helpers?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that sounds like a good idea.
Well then, let's go find some helpers~

text_block_list.name: Transcend's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Sorry 'bout this...!
I've got local onsen cola and onsen carrots ready as a reward...!
I'm counting on ya!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Now then, let's see if there are any good candidates to help out—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mumuu...!? The local Onsen Cola
is sold out for today...!?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...
I can't believe the hot spring carrots are sold out...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Whoa.
Trai-chan, looks like we got a bite right away, huh~?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Hello, you two. It looks like you're eyeing the local hot spring cola and hot spring carrots, but--

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Actually, my sources tell me that there's enough prepared for two.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
!?
You bastard... Are you telling the truth?!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I'm a completely legitimate informant, you know?
Of course all my intel is thoroughly verified.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Just remember, it's give-and-take.
I'm gonna need you to lend me a hand, too~.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...? Meaning?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Phew...!
Think that's just about carried most of 'em?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Still, to find a sauna in a place like this!
My, what a bold venture!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hot spring carrots eaten here...
...*gulp*. Looks delicious.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to a mutual trade of local hot spring cola
and hot spring carrots, the two agreed to help out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few hours later—

text_block_list.name: Transcend's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Phew~~...! We made some serious progress.
Thanks, everyone. Let's call it a day!

text_block_list.name: Transcend's Friend
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's have dinner! We've got cola, hot spring carrots, and barbecue all ready to go!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
――! Onsen carrots... meat... white rice...
...I'm looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... put this like that, and there.
Put this one like this, and there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon returning to the log cabin,
I found Transcend tinkering with something.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trai-chan.
I found something pretty neat.
—Look, a radio. You just know this thing puts out some crazy emotional tunes, right?
choice_data_list: Huh... It definitely sounds like it'd make an emotional sound.
Huh... It definitely sounds like it'd make an emotional sound.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Right? It looks like it's almost fixed~
Just watch and see.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Alright, done!
Now then—click.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I turned on the power and adjusted the antenna—
and through the crackling static, a nostalgic old pop song began to play.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Listening to the nostalgic sounds floating
from the radio, my body naturally begins
to relax...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it really soaks right in~...
Aaah~...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Gaaah! So this is onsen cola!
It kinda has the taste of hot springs to it!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
“Yes. It has a faint scent of hot springs...
Hot spring carrots—they are delicious.”

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, thank you for your hard work, everyone~!
How about some music to go with your meal?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to let everyone listen too, I decided to bring a radio.
When I turned it on, an old showtune started playing.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: —Ooh, this old pop song! How nostalgic~! My father used to sing it all the time when I was little!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. That sounds familiar to me, too.
My mother used to sing it often... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well then, how about we all sing a little song together?
Here we go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under the night sky, we enjoyed a barbecue
while humming nostalgic tunes together.
—It was a truly wonderful time.
